page.notes: The right-hand strip is show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. Marginal notes on the right edge are not legible enough to transcribe reliably. Several words in the running text are doubtful, notably "aflruit", "perscribi" and "Rheginone", which may be printing errors. The line "Con-" at the foot may be a catchword or a partial word from the facing page.
